info.title: Football Player Intelligence API - contract
info.description: CONTRACT ONLY - nothing here is implemented. Step 3.1 (identity/provenance) + Step 3.2 (paths). Every leaf property has x-source (real table/column) or x-derived (rule). x-status: IMPLEMENTABLE_TODAY = producible from the current DB; SCHEMA_ONLY = table exists but is empty; PLANNED = not produced yet, always nullable/availability-tagged. Examples were generated from a local sandbox run of the real pipeline (16,107 EA players + the two sample fixtures); timestamps belong to that run.

get.description: Honest status of every data domain, including the ones that do not exist yet (injury source, model). is_live is always false today.

get.summary: Search all 16,107 EA players (+ canonical aliases)
get.description: Filters are AND-combined. Names are NOT identifiers (124 EA display names occur more than once), so every item carries club/nationality/position/date_of_birth and a stable id. Each item carries quick EA value, source-market-value availability, injury status and image if any. Model estimate is included as the PLANNED block (NOT_YET_INTEGRATED today).

get.summary: Per-field, per-source values and link states

EntityKind.description: CANONICAL = a row exists in players (matching produced MATCHED/PROBABLE_MATCH). EA_ONLY = player exists only as an EA FC26 record; NO canonical identity is created or inferred.

MatchStatus.description: First four equal identity_matches.match_status CHECK values. NOT_EVALUATED is API-only: matching was never run for this player against this source (e.g. Wikidata enrichment only iterates canonical players).

DataOrigin.x-derived: server-side source registry keyed by source name (NOT parsed from dataset_version: wikidata fixture rows are currently stamped 'live:<date>', see KNOWN GAP G2).

Availability.description: Why a value block is empty. NOT_MATCHED = player has no link to the source. NO_SOURCE_DATA = linked, but source has no value. NOT_YET_INTEGRATED = capability does not exist yet (ML model). Never collapse into null/0. EA detailed attributes use NOT_YET_INTEGRATED too (not stored in the DB yet).

InjuryStatus.description: First three equal injury_data_status.status CHECK values. NOT_EVALUATED is API-only: injury_data_status rows exist only for canonical players, so EA_ONLY players have no row.

PlayerId.description: PUBLIC, STABLE handle: 'ea:<ea_fc26_id>' (works for all 16,107 EA players; never changes when a player later becomes canonical). 'p:<player_uid>' is an INTERNAL alias: accepted on input for canonical players, never returned as `id`.

LinkState.description: State of the link between this player and ONE external source. `confidence`/`matched_on` are present ONLY for MATCHED/PROBABLE_MATCH. For AMBIGUOUS/UNMATCHED/NOT_EVALUATED they are null and candidate ids/names are never exposed (an AMBIGUOUS candidate may already belong to another canonical player).

reference_data_origin.description: What the player was compared AGAINST. UNMATCHED against a SAMPLE_FIXTURE (5 players) means 'not in the sample', not 'not in the real world'.

wikidata_id.description: null unless linked. Read v_players, never players (DATABASE_SCHEMA.md warning).

EaIngameValue.description: EA FC26 in-game value. NOT a real-world market value.

SourceMarketValue.description: Real-world market value from the market-value source (Transfermarkt dataset). Today: SAMPLE_FIXTURE, 5 players, illustrative amounts.

ModelEstimate.description: ML estimate. Its TARGET is EA in-game value (notebook target log1p(value_eur) from EA/SoFIFA), so it must never be labelled or compared as a market-value prediction without that caveat. PLANNED: the backend does not produce it yet; today availability is always NOT_YET_INTEGRATED and amount_eur/model_version are null.

Values.description: Three separate blocks, never merged, never a generic 'value' field.

PlayerImage.description: Only Wikidata/Commons images are allowed (owner decision). SoFIFA player_face_url is explicitly out of scope.

PlayerCore.description: Identity-display fields, each read from player_field_values with source = ea_fc26 (works for EA_ONLY, where player_uid IS NULL and source_record_id = ea_fc26_id).

PlayerSummary.description: Search/autocomplete item. Carries enough to disambiguate (124 EA display names are duplicated) and to label data honestly.

generated_at.x-derived: response time (NOT data freshness; see provenance)

contains_sample_data.x-derived: true if any block in this response has data_origin = SAMPLE_FIXTURE (source registry)

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json). 404 is ONLY for an unknown player; a known player with no data is 200 with an Availability, never 404.

matched_alias.description: Set when the query matched a display_name from another source (canonical players only), not the EA name.

total.x-derived: exact count of matching players (all pages)

next_offset.x-derived: offset+limit, or null on the last page

provenance.description: One entry per source that contributed ANY block of this response.

MarketValueResponse.description: Real-world market value history (market_value_history). Points are sorted by valuation_date ASC, then dataset_version ASC (the table is append-only across dataset versions, so the same date can appear twice). `latest` = highest valuation_date, ties -> newest dataset_version. No derived trend/difference fields: none is produced by the backend.

EaDetailedAttributes.description: PLANNED. Detailed EA attributes (pace, finishing, dribbling, ...) are NOT stored in the database (ea_fc26_attributes.raw_json is NULL for every row). Today: availability = NOT_YET_INTEGRATED and attributes = null. Tracked as the separate 'Backend Data Integrity - EA detailed attributes' step.

attributes.x-derived: null until the data-integrity step stores these values

InjuryRecord.description: SCHEMA_ONLY: injury_records table exists but has no writer and no rows. Shape is fixed now; `records` is always [] today.

InjuriesResponse.description: Three-state honesty: `injury.status` is always present. `records` is non-empty ONLY when status = HAS_RECORDS. No derived metrics (burden, frequency): not produced by the backend.

values.description: One entry per source; disagreeing sources are BOTH listed, never merged.

last_fetched_at.description: Latest load timestamp for that source (market value: market_value_history.imported_at). This is when WE first loaded the currently served data (a no-op rerun does not advance it), not when the source last changed.

record_count.x-derived: count of source records (players) loaded from that source

is_live.x-derived: constant false: no provider retrieves live data today (live: is reserved for a future real endpoint path)

status.x-derived: ok iff database reachable and migrations applied

PlayerIdPath.name: player_id
PlayerIdPath.description: Use ea:<id>. p:<uid> is an internal alias.

Q.name: q
Q.description: Trimmed, then normalised (Unicode NFKD accent-strip, casefold, whitespace collapsed). Matched against the EA display_name of every player and, for CANONICAL players only, display_name values from other sources (reported in match.matched_alias).

SortQ.name: sort
SortQ.description: relevance = match quality (EXACT<PREFIX<TOKEN_PREFIX<SUBSTRING), then overall_rating DESC, then ea_fc26_id ASC. All sorts end with ea_fc26_id ASC, so order is total and paging is stable.

OffsetQ.name: offset
OffsetQ.description: Offset paging. ASSUMPTION: data changes only when an ingestion run completes, so offsets are stable between runs.

NotFound.description: PLAYER_NOT_FOUND - id is well-formed but no such EA player / canonical uid.

Unavailable.description: DATA_UNAVAILABLE - database unreachable or migrations not applied.
